inicio.descripcion: Discover new digital skills through simple courses and educational resources designed to help everyone learn.
inicio.imagenAlt: Students using digital tools to learn
inicio.seccionDescripcion: Find educational resources designed to make learning easier.
inicio.beneficio1Descripcion: Lessons explained in a clear and understandable way.
inicio.beneficio2Descripcion: An experience that considers different needs.
inicio.beneficio3Descripcion: Develop useful skills for your daily life.

cursos.descripcion: Explore our courses and develop new digital skills from scratch.
cursos.curso1Descripcion: Learn how to use a computer, operate the keyboard and organize files.
cursos.curso2Descripcion: Discover how to browse, search for information and use different websites.
cursos.curso3Descripcion: Learn how to use email and other digital tools.
cursos.curso4Descripcion: Learn how to protect your personal data and browse safely.

nosotros.descripcion: We believe that everyone deserves opportunities to learn.
nosotros.historiaDescripcion: Aprende sin Barreras was created with the idea of making digital education more accessible. We want to provide a space where people can gain technological knowledge through simple and accessible content.
nosotros.misionDescripcion: Make digital skills easier to learn through accessible and inclusive educational resources.
nosotros.visionDescripcion: To be a digital educational space where everyone can learn without barriers.
nosotros.compromisoDescripcion: Promote equal opportunities and access to information.

accesibilidad.descripcion: Our goal is to make it possible for anyone to browse and learn on our platform.
accesibilidad.seccionTitulo: How do we make learning easier?
accesibilidad.seccionDescripcion: We will implement features that help people with different needs use the website.
accesibilidad.perceptibleDescripcion: We will use alternative text, captions, appropriate contrast and content that can be understood visually and auditorily.
accesibilidad.operableDescripcion: We will allow users to navigate through the pages using the keyboard and keep the focus visible.
accesibilidad.comprensibleDescripcion: We will provide clear instructions, simple text and easy-to-use forms.
accesibilidad.robustoDescripcion: We will organize the HTML correctly to make it easier for browsers and assistive technologies to interpret.
accesibilidad.compromisoDescripcion: We will continuously work to improve the website's accessibility using the WCAG 2.1 guidelines as a reference.

contacto.descripcion: If you have any questions or suggestions, you can get in touch with us.

footer.descripcion: We are an educational platform that promotes accessible and inclusive digital learning. We want everyone to have the opportunity to learn.
